versions.changelog:
Initial release – introduces an end-to-end email design flow focused on distinctive, on-brand outputs, with anti-generic safeguards:

- Produces a structured design brief, then translates it into sending tool section formats.
- Minimizes user input by intelligently inferring brand settings from the ESP or project files; asks at most three targeted questions only if needed.
- Enforces anti-slop visual and content principles—own a colour, real imagery, single-column layouts, precise whitespace, and authentic footers.
- Selects deliberate design archetypes (not just minimal) for various email purposes.
- Fully self-contained; no dependencies on other skills.
